text:
alana: Quick sweep found outdated snippets in onboarding READMEs that set API keys inline, e.g. `const API_KEY = 'YOUR_KEY'` then used in fetch. This keeps showing up from copy/paste.

cho: Ugh. Which READMEs?

alana: onboarding/js-quickstart, examples/widget, and docs/static/embed. Also a TS example imports the old package name, so new users get runtime errors.

rachel: We should standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY and SDK-first examples. Node: `const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })`. Python: `client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))`.

cho: I'll update infra/docs-templates generator so it emits SDK constructor code instead of manual header examples. Add mac/linux and PowerShell notes.

alana: Adding a short CONTRIBUTING.md entry "Example hygiene" (no plaintext keys, prefer env vars, prefer SDK constructors, include note on retries/backoff).

ci-bot: docs lint: scanning for disallowed tokens... found `YOUR_KEY` in examples/widget/README.md

doc-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/921 branch: docs/samples-hygiene. Preview: https://deploy.preview/921

rachel: Can we add a docs CI job `no-inline-keys` that fails on tokens like YOUR_KEY/REPLACE_ME/INSERT_KEY? That will prevent regressions.

cho: Yep, adding it now. Also a unit test to assert generated samples include `RedwoodClient`.

alana: After merge, send a short announcement to #announcements for contributors to follow the new guidance.

doc-bot: docs CI passed on branch; PR merged. 6 files changed.

cho: I'll sweep other repos (widget, examples) and open follow-ups if anything else turns up. Thanks! :thumbsup:
